description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. (3:02) Speaking of circumcision, Pastor Bohr stated that “it was an outward visible manifestation of an internal experience that God expected Israel to have in their hearts. Leviticus 12:3 states that a man child should be circumcised on the 8th day. Since a child who is only 8 days old has no capacity to have such an internal experience or to arrive at any kind of a decisional conviction, how is the concept outlined in the paragraph above possible? Was it based on the internal belief of the parents? I did not know that circumcision when it was biblical law, required any kind of prior internal belief or conviction. I thought it was only a physical sign of the covenant between God and Abraham or the Israelites. I am not trying to be picky, but I really need to understand this and would appreciate some clarification on the subject.
2. (11:30) I would be grateful to hear your thoughts on Revelation 17:16. 
3. (19:57) I was listening to a well-known SDA pastor give a sermon titled, “Babylon has fallen: All God’s Enemies Will Fail”. He talked about the spirit of Babylon and how it can even be in us. Much of what he said seemed accurate to me. However, he said, “It was not one man; it was not the Pope; Ellen White said it was a symbol of the world at large. Because I’ve only been learning and studying for about three years now and have much more to learn, my heart genuinely loves God and I want to stay in God’s truths and not be led astray. It is my understanding that when Babylon has fallen, this is referring to the papal system falling and all will see they’ve been deceived by the pope’s teachings. Am I correct? And if so, does this verse apply: "to the law and to the testimony, if they speak not according to this word it is because there is no light in them". If so, am I not to watch and listen to them anymore?
4. (26:00) Referring to Matthew 24:14, how would Jesus come back soon if people in countries like Saudi Arabia, China, North Korea, etc. haven’t been reached mainly because of their government preventing the gospel from reaching the people?
.
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.

The People of God Are Called upon To Come out of Babylon
